todos.content: Verify Postgres version (>= 12) in target environments
Confirm DB permissions to create schema/tables and run migrations
Decide and document Postgres schema name for Graphile Worker (graphile_worker)
Document DATABASE_URL handling and secrets management
Add graphile_worker crate dependency to Cargo.toml (latest stable)
Ensure tokio, tracing, serde, serde_json, anyhow/thiserror, chrono, sqlx dependencies present
Add worker binary target (e.g., backfill-worker) in Cargo.toml
Validate clippy/rustfmt settings for new binary target
Invoke Graphile Worker RS migrations at startup (schema graphile_worker)
Add a migration runner path in non-prod and test environments
CI: apply migrations before integration tests run
Document migration process in README (how to run/rollback)
Define named queues: fast, bulk, dead_letter
Define priority bands: fast −10 (−20 for emergencies), bulk 0..+10 (lower number = higher priority)
Define default retry policy: max_attempts=8 with exponential backoff schedule
Document insert-at-front policy (very low priority + run_at=now)
Design enqueue() helper signature and error types (includes job_key, run_at, priority)
Implement enqueue() wrapper over Graphile Worker with job_key idempotency
Add integration tests for enqueue() including job_key dedup semantics
Provide convenience helpers: enqueue_fast(), enqueue_bulk()
Scaffold backfill-worker binary with config loading (env)
Register job handlers and task routing in worker
Implement per-queue concurrency (fast/bulk) via config
Implement error classification: retryable vs non-retryable with mapping to backoff/DLQ
Implement graceful shutdown and worker heartbeat/lease behavior
(Optional) Expose health/ready endpoints for k8s/systemd integration
Configure dead_letter named queue and standard DLQ metadata (last_error, attempts, timestamps)
Publish to dead_letter when max_attempts exceeded or non-retryable error
Provide CLI/admin function to re-enqueue jobs from DLQ after remediation
Integration test: DLQ flow and re-enqueue path
Add tracing spans for claim/execute/ack with job_key, queue, priority, attempts
Expose Prometheus metrics: queue depth, enqueue→start, duration, attempts, failures, DLQ counts, lag
Implement structured logging fields and log levels
Create Grafana dashboard for queue health (latency, lag, throughput, DLQ)
Add alerts for lag, failure rate, and DLQ volume thresholds
CI/test env: start Postgres via Docker and set DATABASE_URL
Test: priority ordering and insert-front preemption
Test: run_at scheduling and soft-deadline lag measurement
Test: retries follow exponential backoff schedule
Test: job_key idempotency ensures single execution
Test: multi-queue isolation and per-queue concurrency limits
Test: non-retryable error routes job to DLQ
(Optional) Benchmark: LISTEN/NOTIFY vs polling dispatch latency
Ensure tests wrap in transactions and roll back for cleanup
Update .github/workflows/test.yaml to run Postgres service
CI: run migrations before tests; set schema to graphile_worker
CI: run cargo nextest for integration tests
CI: ensure clippy and fmt pass with new code
README: add worker usage, env config, and migration instructions
Add docs/operating-runbook.md for DLQ procedures and scaling guidance
Document metrics and Grafana dashboards for ongoing ops
Non-prod rollout: deploy worker + minimal producer; backfill burst test
Tune per-queue concurrency and downstream rate limits using metrics
Staging validation of SLOs (lag, throughput, failure rate)
Plan production rollout and rollback strategy; define guardrails
Production rollout; monitor dashboards and alerts; capture learnings
Audit dependency licenses; avoid AGPL unless explicitly approved
Record third-party license notices if required
Add monitoring for autovacuum/dead tuples on job tables
Draft partitioning/retention plan if job table growth is high (future)
Configure DB pool sizes/timeouts appropriate for workers
(Future) Outline optional Redis/Apalis integration plan if throughput needs change
